decisions.decision: Backlot expansion bid work will be scheduled for summer rather than winter.
Hedge trimming will be done on a two-year cycle going forward.
South Cemetery stone wall repair will be completed before starting similar work at North Cemetery, done one section at a time.
Next meetings set for October 30th and November 19th, with a target of meeting again in the second week of December rather than skipping to February.
A SIMS software training session will be scheduled separately and will not be publicized or recorded as a regular open meeting.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Cemetery Commission approved three sets of prior meeting minutes, reviewed cemetery fund expenditures and balances, and voted to draw an additional $10,000 from the sale-of-lots fund to cover hedge trimming and grounds work. what_happened.line: The Commission voted to draw additional money from the sale-of-lots fund to cover a hedge-trimming shortfall.
The board then voted to approve the hedge trimming expenditure itself for North Cemetery.
Hedge trimming moves to a two-year cycle going forward, after storm damage to the hedges was reviewed.
South Cemetery's collapsed stone wall will be rebuilt section by section before similar work starts at North Cemetery.
A Massachusetts preservation grant was discussed but this cycle's deadline was too close to prepare an application.

why_it_matters: This draws from a dedicated cemetery trust fund rather than the general tax levy, and covers grounds upkeep at both cemeteries.
The stone wall and hedge decisions set a maintenance schedule that will recur in future budget cycles.
Missing this grant cycle means the preservation project cost, if pursued, is more likely to fall to the fund itself next time.
